Exercise A

Listening: Tram Delay

You will hear each recording twice, just like in the real MSA exam. Listen carefully, then answer the questions below — you won't be able to play a recording more than twice.

Part 1 — Station Announcement
Part 1 — Comprehension Questions

1 How long is the tram delayed?

2 What caused the delay?

3 How often does the replacement bus run?

4 Where does the replacement bus stop for hospital passengers?

5 What time is normal service expected to resume?

Part 2 — Dialogue: Two Friends
Part 2 — Comprehension Questions

6 Why doesn't Zoe want to walk?

7 What does Zoe suggest they take instead?

8 Why do they need to hurry?

Exercise B

Reading: Transport Options & Notices

Read the texts below, then answer the questions — just like Reading Parts 1 and 2 in the real MSA exam.

Part 1 — Match the Passenger to the Transport Option

Night Bus N5: Runs every 30 minutes after midnight, connecting the city centre to the suburbs — ideal if you finish work or an event late at night.

Cycle Hire Scheme: Rent a bike by the hour from stations around town — great for short trips across the centre in good weather.

Park & Ride: Park your car at the edge of town and take a shuttle bus into the centre — perfect if you're driving in from outside town.

Student Travel Card: Unlimited bus travel for a fixed monthly fee — ideal if you travel to school every single day.

1 Anna finishes her waitressing shift at 1am and needs to get home safely. She should use the .

2 Karl drives in from a nearby village and doesn't want to pay for parking in the centre. He should use .

3 Priya takes the bus to school and back every single day. She should get a .

4 Oliver wants to explore the town centre for an hour on a sunny afternoon. He should use the .

Part 2 — Transport Notices: True or False?

🚲 Hired bikes must be returned to any station within the network, not necessarily the one you hired them from.

🚏 The Park & Ride shuttle bus runs every ten minutes during rush hour.

🎫 Student Travel Cards are only valid on buses, not on trams.

👶 Children under five travel free on all local buses and trams.

5 Bicycles must be returned to the exact station you hired them from.

6 The Park & Ride shuttle runs every ten minutes at rush hour.

7 Student Travel Cards can be used on trams as well as buses.

8 Children under five must pay full price on buses and trams.

Exercise C

Writing: Blog Post

Choose ONE of the two prompts below and write 80–100 words, just like Writing Part 3 in the real MSA exam. This section is graded by your teacher, not automatically.

Choose ONE prompt

Prompt 1: Describe a time public transport was delayed and explain how you dealt with it.

Prompt 2: Write a message to a friend explaining you will be late because of a transport delay, and suggest a new plan.
